Name: Hot Pam
Author: moirgane
Description:
I wanted to give Pam a makeover and turn her into a hot trailer mom! I have this backstory in my head that Pam used to be a... working girl to provide for Penny. Her dislike of tentacles could be bringing up not too fond memories.

Portrait and Sprite change included!

[color=#ff0000][b]**Update 02/02/2020[/b][/color]
We had to remove the original DCBurger optional portrait and all images of it. This mod was almost permanently deleted for offering that, even though we attributed the artist's work and were only offering it because we loved the art so much. Thankfully, the NexusMods staff is very rational and reasonable, and allowed the mod to be restored as long as we removed the DCBurger optional file. Thank you NexusMods!

Also as of 1.4, Hot Pam no longer includes XNB files. Please use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]. It's much less likely to break your game.

[color=#00ff00][b]**Update 08/09/2018
[/b][/color]
Updated the mod files for Content Patcher support. Downloads still include XNB files for those who prefer manual installation.
[i]Thank you very much to user wetfart for the update![/i]

[b][color=#00ffff]**Update 02/07/2018

[/color][/b]I'm back into the game for multiplayer and saw all the new mods. I fell in love with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/888]DCBurger's Portraits[/url] and wanted my mod to work well with it. Just follow the install instructions on their mod page! :)

(wetfart 02/02/2020 - original DCBurger portrait mod was removed a while ago and reposted with new permissions, requiring us to stop redistributing - see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]reposted version with copyright claims[/url]) 

[color=#ff00ff][b]**Update[/b]
[/color]
I've made (to the best of my ability ><) a version that looks like the default game art. I hope it fits enough and you guys like it!

[color=#d5a6bd]How to Install:[/color]

Install SMAPI and Content Patcher. Extract mod download to Stardew Valley/Mods directory. See readme for more detailed instructions.
